title: spec: one exported builder for the translateObject options /meta uses, instead of nine inline copies
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #35384 (PR #36464). Raised by the #35384 dev. Filed by the seat. Parent: #35384.

## What happens

The resolve options a server-side reader must pass to `translateObject` so that it matches `/meta` (the locale chain, the packaged base, the pair bundle) are built inline in about nine places, because no builder is reachable from the plugins. Each copy can drift from `/meta`, and #36464 adds three more.

## To do

1. Add one exported builder in `@objectstack/spec` that turns a request context and the held catalogs into the options `/meta` uses.
2. Move every inline copy onto it, `/meta` included.
3. Pin that `/meta` and one plugin reader build equal options for the same request.

## Acceptance

- No reader builds those options inline; all call the one builder, and the label answers do not change.

This adds a public export to `@objectstack/spec`, so its review is at the contract tier.

## Grade
p3 · domain:spec. Duplication that invites drift.
